rule.statement: The 5th defendant cannot claim any right to the corpus because Awin Wickramasinghe had already denuded and disposed of his rights to the house by transferring the corpus together with the land, plantations and everything standing thereon to the plaintiff.
rule.supporting_quote: In the aforesaid circumstances, my considered view is that the 5th defendant cannot claim any right to the corpus. Hence, I answer the 1st and 2nd questions of law raised before this Court in the negative and in favour of the plaintiff.
